cardNote: GolfTraxx per-hole yardages retrieved October 14, 2026; each tee total agrees with the official virtual yardage book (6,547/6,119/5,335/4,922). Ratings/slopes are unset because the official Course Details and Virtual Yardage Book pages conflict. Confirm current card/tee markers on arrival. Red is omitted because its published stroke indexes differ from the shared men’s row.
